attribution.cause: the certificate anchor clips its support at the topology read's unadmitted-saddle level (a fraction of the way inside the core lobe) instead of the analytic separatrix level, excluding the outer-flux shell of the core lobe from its own current; the frozen currents integrate the full core lobe, so the gate's error is the flux image of that excluded shell
attribution.hypothesis_coil_or_external_omitted: refuted: the certificate row's external is included by construction
attribution.hypothesis_core_lobe_integration: confirmed: the production oracle currents clip at the read's level, not the core lobe; pinning the clip to the analytic separatrix restores the core lobe and removes the anomaly
attribution.hypothesis_gauge: consistent: the production error is the shell field (corr 0.9957), not a constant or scale offset
attribution.hypothesis_homogeneous_harmonics: refuted: both current sets omit the same harmonic part, which cancels in the frozen-minus-certificate difference
attribution.hypothesis_private_flux_region: refuted: the missing current is the outer core-lobe shell, not the region below the X-point
